prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one panoramic lifestyle campaign illustration for CT Life, wide landscape approximately 16:9, full opaque scene. Original world/character concept, not a gameplay screenshot.
Input image role: use the supplied selected hero ONLY as a CAST AND RENDERING STYLE REFERENCE. Create a new scene and new actions, not a background swap of its bench composition. Retain the recognizable purple-clad Black female builder, the brown-skinned mint-streetwear female friend, and the friendly original frog-headed person in a charcoal suit. Only these three characters appear.
Scene: a lived-in, compact urban rooftop apartment in warm late-afternoon golden hour. An open terrace overlooks tasteful compact CT City architecture and a quiet skyline. Show a little kitchen through an open sliding glass door, a comfortable chair and a small table, lush potted plants, groceries and a discreet laundry corner. It must feel like an actual inviting home rather than a giant luxury mansion or an empty design showroom.
Actions: the purple-clad builder has finished work, her laptop visibly CLOSED nearby, and carries TWO drinks toward the table. The mint-clad friend is seated, chatting warmly with her. The suited frog is awkwardly but tenderly watering a lush potted plant with a small watering can. Casual recognizable everyday friendship, gentle character humor, no trading spectacle.
Style: exceptionally polished authored stylized 3D game key art, exactly the sculpted adult character language of the reference. Simplified clean sculpted hair/clothing, soft expressive modeled faces, intentional slightly toy-like material modeling with adult proportions, matte fabrics, ceramic furniture, subtle glossy accents. Not photoreal people, not chibi, not stiff mannequins. Coherent lavender, mint, warm cream and charcoal material palette, lush natural greens.
Composition: premium editorial panorama with layered foreground/middle/background depth, natural three-quarter camera and clean uncluttered staging. Main character action is centered and toward the RIGHT. Reserve the LOWER LEFT as a darker but still detailed and believable quiet part of the room/terrace for a live HTML caption overlay; do not put an important face, bright prop or busy action there. Do not draw any caption, frame, text plate or artificial blank rectangle. Warm soft golden light and carefully directed long shadows; beautiful restrained atmospheric skyline.
Constraints: full opaque artwork to the image edges, no transparency. No text, logos, ads, UI, charts, coins, money, watermark, fantasy mansion, fake gameplay capture or CT logo. No other characters. Keep the original cast recognizable and beautifully integrated into this new lived-in place.

inspection.observed: Three cast members at a compact rooftop apartment: purple builder holds two drinks, mint friend is seated chatting, suited original frog waters a potted plant. Closed laptop on table, kitchen and laundry visible. Full opaque scene; no drawn text, logos, UI or money imagery.
inspection.limitations: Lower-left is quiet but contains some bright golden light; actual caption contrast needs webpage review. Fictional skyline includes mountains and is not proof of playable city geometry. Character likeness/style continuity is judged visually, not exact pixel preservation.

claims: Original generated marketing/world concept art. No actual gameplay, playable housing, backend, user approval or rendered engine scene claim. Hero files and approved logo were not modified.
